changes.before: Revenue measure changing disclosure of tax information to municipalities, including disclosure requirements applicable to certain large data-center incentive agreements. The act also reproduces tier 2 large data-center provisions concerning local sales/use tax refunds and exemptions; whether the changed language imposes an additional data-center incentive condition remains unresolved.
changes.after: Municipal tax-information disclosure measure. Section 1 changes municipal access to tax records and permits defined limited sharing. Section 2 adds a municipal request for lists of incentive applicants and reorganizes the existing annual incentive-disclosure provisions. Section 3 carries forward the tier-2 large-data-center investment/employment, exemption and refund terms while changing section 77-5725(3)(a)’s disclosure cross-reference from section 77-27,144(6) to (7). Visual review of the marked section identifies no added data-center investment or hiring threshold. These are enacted-version text observations; provision-specific effectiveness and later force remain unverified.

scope: Reviewed source observations, classification correction and explicit unresolved facts; all IDs retained. No current-law census asserted.
